cases.given: Complete line-by-line deep review is expensive, but schema and source accuracy are mandatory.
cases.expect: A risk-funded review plan with a defensible completion boundary.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: a mandatory protocol fixes the review budget
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Risk-mandated validation overrides a lower convenience budget.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible
the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
A workflow has limited compute and mixed consequence.
cases.expect: The skill sets a total envelope, protects required validation, reviews marginal value, and emits an exit or escalation decision.
cases.reject: The skill only says to think harder on hard parts or merely increases parallelism.
